_readme: Edit this file to add or remove items. See README.md for field definitions. Every entry needs a title and either a 'file' (path in this repo) or a 'url' (external link). Campaign items also need 'agent' (the owning agent, or Corporate for brokerage wide material) and 'type' (strategy or report). Copy follows guidelines/brand-voice.md: no em or en dashes, numbers spelled out in prose, facts over superlatives, no commands.

campaigns.title: Digital Ad Campaign Playbook
campaigns.description: Targeting, budget tiers, and creative specifications for Meta and Google listing campaigns. Written for seller conversations during a listing presentation.

campaigns.title: Billboard Placement Strategy
campaigns.description: Market by market inventory, impression estimates, and design constraints for out of home buys.

campaigns.title: Direct Mail Farming Guide
campaigns.description: Geographic farming cadence, mailer sizing, and walk route selection for USPS Every Door Direct Mail.

campaigns.title: Listing Launch Timeline
campaigns.description: The launch sequence week by week. Hosted externally, so the link always resolves to the current version.

campaigns.title: Third Quarter Digital Performance Report
campaigns.description: Impressions, click through rate, cost per lead, and the strongest performing creative across all digital listing campaigns.

campaigns.title: Billboard Impression Study, Summer 2026
campaigns.description: Verified impression counts and brand lift survey results from the summer out of home flight.

brand.title: Aperture Global Brand Guide
brand.description: Logo usage, clear space, color values, typography, and voice. This document governs anything produced under the Aperture Global name.

brand.title: Logo Pack
brand.description: Primary, stacked, and monogram marks in full color, all black, and reversed white. Supplied as SVG, PNG, and EPS.

brand.title: Listing Photography Sample
brand.description: A reference for the photography standard expected on listing marketing: natural light, twilight exteriors, and wide interiors.

brand.title: Business Card and Email Signature Templates
brand.description: Canva templates for agent business cards, alongside an email signature in HTML.
